title.zh: 统一国民政府预算组人员薪金并更改预算业务处特定人员的职衔
title.en: An Act Standardizing the Salaries of the Personnel Constituting the Budgeting Group in the National Government and Changing the Designations of Certain Personnel in the Budget Operations Service
title.orig: An Act Standardizing the Salaries of the Personnel Constituting the Budgeting Group in the National Government and Changing the Designations of Certain Personnel in the Budget Operations Service

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_6029_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The changes in designations and adjustment of the old annual rates of salaries to the annual rates prescribed in the corresponding step in the new salary ranges of certain personnel in the Budget Operations Service of the Budget Commission as well as of the budget officers and budget examiners in the different agencies of the National Government, as indicated hereunder, are hereby authorized;
Old Salary Ranges From
New Salary Ranges To
Positions
Range (Minimum Maximum) Range (Minimum Maximum)
(a) Chief, Budget Operations Services R-62 (12,516-15,264) R-66 (15,264-18,636)
(b) Chief Budget Analysts (chief of Division) R-56 (9,288-11,328) R-62 (12,516-15,264)
(c) Chief Budget Planner R-56 (9,288-11,328) R-62 (12,516-15,264)
(d) Department Budget Officers III R-56 (9,288-11,328) R-60 (11,328-13,824)
(e) Budget Officers VI R-55 (8,832-10,776) R-59 (10,776-13,152)
(f) Department Budget Officers II R-54 (8,400-10,260) R-58 (10,260-12,516)
(g) Assistant Chief Budget Analysts (Assistant Chiefs of Division) R-51 (7,236-8,832) R-57 (9,756-11,904)
(h) Budget Planners R-51 (7,236-8,832) R-57 (9,756-11,904)
(i) Budget Officers V R-53 (7,992-9,756 R-57 (9,756-11,904)
(j) Department Budget Officers I R-52 (7,608-9,288) R-56 (9,288-11,328)
(k) Budget Officers IV R-52 (7,608-9,288) R-56 (9,288-11,328)
(l) Senior Budget Analysts II R-46 (5,640-6,888) R-52 (7,608-9,288)
(m) Budget Officers III R-48 (6,240-7,608) R-52 (7,608-9,288)
(n) Budget Officers II R-46 (5,640-6,888) R-50 (6,888-8,400)
(o) Senior Budget Analysts I R-42 (4,632-5,040) R-48 (6,240-7,608)
(p) Budget Examiners III R-42 (4,632-5,040) R-48 (6,240-7,608)
(q) Budget Officers I R-42 (4,632-5,040) R-46 (5,640-6,888)
(r) Budget Analysts R-39 (3,984-4,860) R-45 (5,376-6,552)
(s) Budget Examiners II R-39 (3,984-4,860) R-43 (4,860-5,928)
(t) Budget Examiners I R-33 (2,952-3,612) R-37 (3,612-4,404)
(u) Budget Aides R-30 (2,544-3,108) R-34 (3,108-3,792)

The provisions of any law, rule or regulation to the contrary notwithstanding, the incumbents to the positions mentioned in Section one hereof shall continue to occupy their respective positions and receive the salary rates as provided in this Act without the necessity of issuing new appointments to them, except for those whose designations were changed under the said section, who shall automatically be issued appointments corresponding to their respective new designations at rates herein respectively provided for them.

Such sums as may be necessary to cover the salary differentials of the personnel provided in Section one are hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated. Henceforth, appropriations to cover their salaries, as herein fixed, shall be carried in the annual General Appropriations Act.
All Acts, executive orders, administrative orders, rules and regulations or parts thereof, inconsistent with any of the provisions of this Act, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effective Date. — This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without executive approval, Aug. 4, 1969.
